verdict.rationale: Gitea ships a broad, versioned REST API with built-in machine-readable Swagger/OpenAPI documents (342 paths under /api/v1), an interactive Swagger UI on every instance, an official Go SDK, and the tea CLI, so much of the UI surface is clearly reachable programmatically. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows UI parity, and dynamic config options are documented only through the admin panel or app.ini. missing for 10: any documented claim or verification of full UI-to-API parity, an API path for admin-panel dynamic configuration, independent hands-on corroboration of API coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: the Swagger 2.0 document at /swagger.v1.json (342 paths, basePath /api/v1)
